test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PAVE : FXDT :: AXLE : FNAE :: BREW : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The fourth alphabet of the second letter-cluster is 4 letters ahead of the first letter of the first letter-cluster.**

**The third alphabet of the second letter-cluster is 3 letters ahead of the second letter of the first letter-cluster.**

**The second alphabet of the second letter-cluster is 2 letters ahead of the third letter of the first letter-cluster.**

The first alphabet of the second letter-cluster is 1 letter ahead of the fourth letter of the first letter-cluster.</st
